newsitem.title: UK: Telefonica to agree TISA future this year.
newsitem.headline: Telefonica to agree TISA future this year.

text.p: Telefonica de Espana SA, Spain's dominant telecoms giant, said on Friday it expected to announce this year whether or not it would buy the government's remaining 23.8 percent stake in its international arm TISA.

"We are very close to reaching an agreement, either positive or negative," Juan Villalonga Navarro, the new chairman and chief executive, told Reuters in an interview. He added that the decision would be made "before the end of the year".
Newspapers have said the stake in TISA (Telefonica Internacional SA) could be sold for 106 billion pesetas -- far short of the 140 billion peseta the Spanish government initially forecast.
Villalonga said no price had yet been agreed.
Telefonica, which is leading telephone company in the Spanish speaking world, already owns 76.2 percent of TISA.

SBC Warburg recently estimated that Telefonica's stake in TISA, based on the market valuation of its three main underlying assets -- Telefonica del Peru, Telefonica de Argentina and CTC in Chile -- was worth about 536 billion pesetas on conservative valuations.
